target: tracker.sh shelve — exit 3 while a stage may be mid-write
cmd:
mkdir -p factory/specs; printf -- '---
id: 001
title: in-flight
status: building
---
body
' > factory/specs/001-a.md; printf -- '---
id: 002
title: reviewing-now
status: reviewing
---
body
' > factory/specs/002-b.md; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh"; if tracker_shelve factory/specs/001-a.md me >/dev/null 2>&1; then B=0; else B=$?; fi; if tracker_shelve factory/specs/002-b.md me >/dev/null 2>&1; then R=0; else R=$?; fi; jq -n --argjson b "$B" --argjson r "$R" --arg s1 "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md status)" --arg s2 "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/002-b.md status)" --arg f1 "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md shelved_from)" '{b: $b, r: $r, s1: $s1, s2: $s2, f1: $f1}'
_note: exit 3 specifically, not a generic 2 — the shelve skill distinguishes 'refused, offer the force flag' from 'usage error, stop'. Nothing may be written on refusal: a half-shelved spec whose status stayed `building` but gained shelved_from would restore to the wrong place.
